name: The Clockwork Vault
description: A heist scenario: break into a mechanized vault before the automaton patrol returns. Planning, teamwork, and improvisation.
openingNarration: The Artificer's Guild vault is legendary — three floors of clockwork traps, mechanical sentries, and a lock that changes its combination every hour on the hour. Inside sits the Orrery of Fates, a device that the Guild claims can predict the future. Your employer wants it. You have until the midnight bell — four hours from now. The Guild's annual gala is your cover. Guests in silk and brass fill the exhibition hall above the vault. A former Guild apprentice named Sparks sold you a partial blueprint of the first floor. The rest, you'll have to figure out as you go.

npcs.name: Sparks
npcs.description: A nervous ex-apprentice with grease-stained fingers and a debt to your employer.
npcs.motivation: Wants the debt cleared and fears the Guild will discover the betrayal

npcs.name: Guildmaster Vex
npcs.description: The vault's architect, a tall figure in a brass mask who designed every trap personally.
npcs.motivation: Suspects someone will try for the Orrery tonight and is watching the gala closely

npcs.name: Lady Ashworth
npcs.description: A wealthy patron attending the gala who has her own reasons for wanting the Orrery.
npcs.motivation: Will offer the party a better deal mid-heist — if they'll double-cross their employer

npcs.name: Cogsworth
npcs.description: A brass automaton guard with a cracked voicebox that repeats the same warning every 90 seconds.
npcs.motivation: Follows patrol patterns exactly, but the cracked voicebox is a useful timer

locations.name: The Exhibition Hall
locations.description: Glittering gala above the vault, guests in masks and brass finery

locations.name: The Maintenance Corridor
locations.description: Service tunnels behind the walls, dusty and narrow, with exposed gears

locations.name: Vault Floor One
locations.description: Pressure plates, dart launchers, and a rotating combination lock

locations.name: Vault Floor Two
locations.description: Clockwork sentries patrol in predictable patterns, but the floor shifts

locations.name: The Orrery Chamber
locations.description: The deepest room — a domed ceiling shows the stars, and the Orrery spins in the center

plotHooks: Sparks' blueprint is incomplete — the second floor isn't on it
Guildmaster Vex is watching the gala guests more carefully than usual tonight
Lady Ashworth approaches the party with a counter-offer mid-heist
The Orrery does more than predict the future — it shows something the Guild doesn't want anyone to see
Cogsworth's patrol pattern has a 30-second gap if timed right

items.name: Sparks' Blueprint
items.description: Partial floor plan of vault level one, grease-smudged

items.name: Gala Invitation
items.description: Forged invitation, good enough to fool the door guards

items.name: Clockwork Lockpick
items.description: Modified tool that adapts to rotating tumblers
